g.text: One token through a V4.1-Flash Engram module (layer 1 or 14)
compressed ids (99,092): NFKC, lowercase, whitespace collapsed
8 hash heads per order: multiplicative-XOR, mod a distinct ~16M prime
24 row indices into the module's FP8 table
Every index depends only on token ids, so the 24 gathers per module are issued before the forward pass; DeepSeek prefetches them from host memory over RDMA
while block 0 computes. Both modules: 48 rows, 12 KiB per token; the projection is ~0.6 GFLOP per token against ~32 GFLOP for the 16B activated backbone.
